title: Media queries appear to be broken on remix docs
author: henryStelle
body_preview: ### Reproduction 1. Visit https://api.remix.run 2. View on a none-desktop viewport ### Expected Behavior A mobile nav is displayed conditionally. ### Actual Behavior The desktop nav is displayed but unclickable when the screen width is less than 640px.

title: Add shared asset configuration and a `remix assets` inspector
author: mjackson
body_preview: ## Summary  Asset URL mappings and browser-access policies currently live only in application code passed to `createAssetServer()`. title: Bug: `on` mixin handler runs twice in "nested" `clientEntry` components
author: okalil
body_preview: ### Reproduction steps 1. Run https://github.com/okalil/remix-3-beta-bugs/tree/main/on-mixin-runs-twice 2. Click the first button, see 'click' logged once. 3. Click the second button, see 'click' logged twice.  ### Expected behavior On click the second button `'click'` is also logged once.  ### Actual behavior On click the second button `'click'` is logged twice.
